card.name: Ends of first names in citations
card.fires_on: The closing or middle piece of a person's first name (Stevie, Billie, Paula, Dickie, Christy, Billy) in a credit, citation or author line, just before a surname.

modes.label: Name ending -ie/-y
modes.description: The final piece of a nickname-style first name such as Stevie, Billie, Dickie or Christy, before a surname.

modes.label: Whole first name after a source label
modes.description: A first name like Billy or Bobby right after a colon or period in an attribution.
